name: The Bilu Sacred Tree

location.address: Central Cross-Island Highway, 14A Line, 127.6 km mark, Xiulin Township, Hualien County
location.neighbourhood: Bilu rest area, Taroko National Park, roughly 2,000m elevation

access: Free, at a public highway rest stop with a car park, cafe, trail and pavilion
transport: By car or bus on the Central Cross-Island Highway; no rail access at this elevation
verify_notes: Was a standing lead in data/leads/_famous-taiwan.json ('Bilu Sacred Tree'). Two independently fetched sources: Hualien County's official tourism office page (tour-hualien.hl.gov.tw, English) gives species Cunninghamia konishii, age over 3,000 years, height ~50m, diameter 3.5m, location 14A line 127.6km, elevation ~2,000m; a Taiwanese outlet (etaiwan.news, Chinese, independently fetched) corroborates species (香杉/巒大杉 = Cunninghamia konishii), age >3,000 years, still alive with foliage, location at 127.7km/~2,150m (minor elevation discrepancy between the two sources, carried as 'roughly 2,000m' rather than picking one figure). A direct fetch of taroko.gov.tw's own page (the official park authority) returned only image/logo data, no readable text, so it is NOT cited as a source despite appearing in search snippets; only the two sources actually read are cited. Checked and ruled OUT during this pass: the original, more famous 'Alishan Sacred Tree' (阿里山神木, not in this leads list under that name) was struck by lightning in 1956, half-collapsed in 1997, and was cut down in 1998 (Taipei Times, Atlas Obscura 'Alishan Sacred Tree Relics'); it is dead and would fail the living-tree hard rule, so it is correctly absent from this leads file and not something to add later. Destination test: passes, it is the largest old tree on Taiwan's Central Cross-Island Highway with a purpose-built rest stop.
destination_test: PASS: reputed over 3,000 years old, tallest/largest old tree on the Central Cross-Island Highway per two sources, a purpose-built highway rest stop exists specifically for it; a genuine specific-tree destination.
